# RegScan

> Free UK vehicle MOT and tax checker. Enter a registration to see live MOT
> status, full MOT history, advisories, and current tax status — from the
> official DVSA MOT History API and DVLA Vehicle Enquiry Service. Free, no
> sign-up, no card. RegScan also flags advisories that recur across multiple
> MOTs, which often signals a worsening fault.

RegScan is independent and not affiliated with the DVSA, DVLA or GOV.UK.

## Tool
- Check a vehicle: https://www.regscan.co.uk/check/
